title: Regularity and Efficiency of Worst-Case Regret Contrasts for Ordinal Outcomes on Support Faces
banked_reason: D0.5 actual BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: incremental < field; paper_score_ceiling 5.1 < 7.4, not salvageable in scope. Sound specialist affine-score regularity and efficient inference; field-level nonaffine weak-margin minimax frontier remains open.
gap_reasons: The field-level shortfall is substantive novelty: the delivered criterion and efficient estimator specialize finite piecewise-affine geometry and established margin-controlled debiasing to one ordinal composite.

The affirmative efficiency result remains confined to known uniform covariates and public supports; it does not settle inference in the published applied experiment, and fractional policies concern a defined affine score rather than actual worst-case regret.

The weak-margin theorem supplies an upper bound and a parametric lower bound, matched in affine architectures and at the specified endpoint, while the genuinely nonaffine rate below that endpoint remains unresolved.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 discharged the supported-chamber regularity criterion, canonical gradient, pointwise efficient estimator, and weak-margin risk upper bound with matched affine/endpoint cases. Independent audits corrected the fractional-policy causal interpretation while retaining the exact target and model; all eight inherited sources were verified and the omitted regret constant was supplemented from the exact appendix proof. The actual D0.5 gate found incremental novelty below the field floor (5.1 < 7.4); the nonaffine weak-margin minimax architecture remains open, and F/Lean formalization was not started.
tldr: The normalized-utility supplied-policy affine regret-score contrast has a finite observable support-tangent regularity criterion and a computable canonical variance in the maintained known-uniform-covariate experiment with public supports, uniform overlap and occupied interiority. It equals the inherited source causal worst-case-regret contrast for deterministic supplied policies; genuinely randomized policies are covered only as a paper-owned affine score. No randomized-policy worst-case-regret identification is asserted. Genuine-face remainder control and primitive Lipschitz fits yield data-only pointwise efficient studentization. In the common restricted deterministic-policy experiment, the effective-face sufficient regime strictly contains the four-component-gap regime, including a five-category positive-variance law outside all four margins. Only nonregularity transfers upward to containing models for a parameter restricting to the same score. The weak-margin risk upper bound and matched affine cases are proved; general nonaffine tightness remains open.
gap: Zhang--Luo--He Supplement Theorem S1 controls four constituent gap lists and smoothing curvature. These sufficient conditions exclude positive-mass ties even when the complete supported regret contrast is affine. Generic directional and conditional-program theory supplies essential machinery; the missing target-specific package is the computed complete boundary, a genuinely face-localized remainder and its strict feasible-inference regime comparison.
fill: Compare reachable chamber coefficients modulo support-simplex annihilators, compute the canonical variance including degeneracy, and pair the exact face distance with projected histograms and cross-fitting. The strict comparison includes a nonempty common full-support regime and a five-category law outside every source margin carried through studentized efficient estimation. No weak-margin named minimax rate is asserted.
